item.text: {"items":[{"id":"k1","verdict":"taught","note":"Sustained high estradiol switches to positive pituitary feedback, triggering the LH surge."},{"id":"k2","verdict":"taught","note":"The corpus luteum produces progesterone for about 14 days unless hCG rescues it, making luteal length relatively fixed."},{"id":"k3","verdict":"missing","note":"Oocyte meiotic arrest sites and timing are not discussed."}]}
